post_gate_decisions.reason: Judgment. The round-2 discount was set as 1.7x off an 8.7x mix-weighted multiple, i.e. 19.5%. Its reasons (NTM growth after the horizon slowing to ~17-26% against peers growing 29-268% on consensus, and one MRA holding most of the backlog) are relative to the peers' level, so they scale with it. Keeping 1.7 turns after the gate cut the base to 6.57x would have raised the discount to 26% with no new fact against Cerebras.

post_gate_decisions.to: included (CRWV 3.80x, NBIS 5.65x; chip/networking median 11.86x -> 11.87x), with Cerebras's own $568.8M deducted as 0.11x
post_gate_decisions.reason: CRWV's $16,319M operating lease liability (10-Q, 2026-06-30) is 18% of its lease-inclusive EV; its data-centre rent is paid out of its revenue, so an ex-lease EV/sales understates what the market pays per revenue dollar. NBIS's leases are $114.9M + $1,510.4M (6-K Ex. 99.2). Cerebras bills data-centre set-up and operating costs to certain customers as pass-through revenue that its core revenue excludes (10-Q), and the engine's bridge carries no lease debt (F7), so I put Cerebras on the same basis by deducting its own $568.8M of operating leases (10-Q) as 568.8 / ~5,021 = 0.11x of horizon NTM revenue. Chip/networking leases are <=0.15% of EV (XBRL) and move nothing.

The multiple applies to horizon NTM revenue (Oct-2027 to Oct-2028, ~$5.02B on the engine), not Q2. Cloud and other services were $126.0M of $180.1M (70.0%) in Q2 2026, and the 10-Q says Cerebras expects them 'to comprise a significantly higher percentage of total revenue in future periods' as the OpenAI MRA delivers; ~90% of FY2028 revenue in this set is RPO conversion, mostly the MRA. I stop at 80% rather than 90% because the 10-Q says the mix 'may vary ... based on OpenAI's deployment options' (some Committed Capacity may be delivered as hardware) and capacity on Cerebras's own silicon keeps part of the chip margin a GPU neocloud pays away. Sensitivity: 70/30 gives 5.4x (fair value ~$102), 90/10 gives 4.3x (~$91).

(0.8 x 4.725 + 0.2 x 11.870) x (1 - 0.1954) - 0.113 = 4.84x, rounded to 4.8x as the run rounds multiples to 0.1x. Cross-checks: ~20x horizon NTM GAAP EBITDA (~$24.1B EV / ~$1.21B), between CRWV 19.2x and NVDA 27.1x trailing (filings); the 14.8%-WACC DCF implies ~4.5x. The three corrections offset: proportional discount and leases raise it (to 5.4x on the Q2 mix), the horizon mix lowers it. So the gate's 4.9x was about right in level but not in construction; the corrected peer figures do not support going back toward the agents' 6.5-7.0x, which rest on the aggregator ratios that failed.

Bear: CRWV lease-inclusive 3.80x with the same 19.5% discount, less 0.11x = 2.94x (4.8 - 1.9). Bull: NVDA 8.98x / AVGO 10.21x lease-inclusive mean 9.59x, no discount, less 0.11x = 9.48x (4.8 + 4.7). Probabilities unchanged (26/50/24).
